openings.claim: Transform-record removal → unchanged-manifest coverage gap → widen the affected divergence interval and prioritize available boundary evidence, using digest comparison and the evidence ledger. Definite stages require earliest supported boundaries, cited records and explicit coverage, rather than merely differing digests. Index identifiers against the manifest; compare corresponding digests; separate observed mismatches from explanations. Equal input/unequal output supports a stage mismatch only when evidence excludes earlier divergence; otherwise report an interval. Timestamp disagreement annotates uncertainty, never proves reordered execution.
openings.discriminator: Rival: a manifest-ordered digest ledger noting gaps without reprioritizing. Conversion should identify claims losing support after removal and redirect bounded inspections. Compare final stage/interval reports, cited support and inspection counts. Accuracy or narrower intervals are not guaranteed; insufficient discriminating records may yield identical intervals.
openings.probe: Compare workflows using disjoint three-pair subsets: six manual inspections per variant per pair, logged; combined cap twelve. Process all six pairs within sixty minutes; compare within twenty additional minutes. Randomly remove one transform record from each of two pairs before final freezing; manifests stay unchanged. Freeze reports, references and resource-fitting next checks before opening two sealed answer sheets. Assess boundary containment, unsupported definite claims and inspection use. Check flagged gaps against already-indexed identifiers: indexing mistakes must not trigger loss claims. Cancellation: available evidence supports the same interval. Breakdown: six-inspection comparison allowance leaves necessary boundaries unread; report unresolved, never infer nonexecution or exceed the cap.
openings.uncertainty: Assumes the supplied environment can index bounded records without adding records. Next checks may inspect existing uninspected boundaries only within remaining allowance; exhausted evidence is explicitly unresolved.

lineage.reason: Relation, rival, comparison/defeat conditions, uncertainty, resource/stopping caveats and declared preserves fit retained.

decision: Retain D1 for a synthetic probe, without deployment or measured-improvement claims. For each pair report the earliest supported divergent stage or unresolved interval, with supplied-record references and a resource-fitting next check.
